systems.owner: Commandement de la sécurité publique, Commandement des forces de police

note: The ministry's summary of Décret 2019-376 lists the police command's organisation only: a transmissions and IT directorate, an information-processing division in the general staff, an archiving and information-processing division and Interpol and Afripol bureaux in the judicial police command. It names no system in which a station records a report or a case and describes none; the emergency call centre is named with no description of what it does.
